stories.headline: Japan take a fourth Pacific Nations Cup title
stories.summary: Japan have won the Pacific Nations Cup for the fourth time. They beat Fiji 20–15 in the final in Tokyo on 19 September. The semi-finals had been played in Ōsaka a week earlier, on 12 September.

stories.headline: Bolivia's senate backs a loan of US$1.9 billion
stories.summary: Bolivia's Senate has ratified an agreement to take a loan of US$1.9 billion from the International Monetary Fund. The country is in a deep economic crisis. Trade unions have threatened renewed protests in response.

stories.headline: A new snake from New Guinea is named after Slash
stories.summary: Researchers have named a newly identified snake from New Guinea Lielaphis slashi, or Slash's groundsnake. It honours the Guns N' Roses guitarist, who has been fascinated by reptiles for most of his life. The reddish-brown snake measures 28 inches long and was collected in the island's forests.
